description:

Foundever® is the next\-generation services leader reinventing customer experience (CX). Built on diverse and proven industry experience, we proudly combine the latest in digital operations with a 150,000\-strong, people\-led workforce across \+45 countries.  



Each year we enable 3\.3 billion conversations in \+60 languages for more than 800 world\-leading brands, helping them keep their brand promises in every moment that matters. We are building new ways to simplify the complexity of change, accelerate digital transformation and create measurable brand and business momentum for our clients.

How’s it going so far? Here’s what others have to say about the work we’re doing: check out our award\-winning results.

And, we’re having fun while we do it – learn more about our award\-winning culture.

Get to know more about us at foundever.com and connect with us on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.  


**Or hear directly from our people about what it’s like to wake up and keep brand promises:** Foundever stories.**Job Summary**

Conversational Designer for Chatbots and Voicebots is responsible for creating, designing, and optimizing the user interaction experience with AI\-driven conversational interfaces. Their role involves understanding client issues and expected outcomes (efficiency, automation, reduction of AHT) and user needs. The CD will be in charge of designing the conversation flow, scripting dialogues, and ensuring that the bot can understand and respond to user queries effectively and naturally. They work to make the interaction as human\-like as possible, often employing principles of psychology, linguistics, and user\-centered design. Additionally, they analyze conversation data to identify patterns, improve responses, and enhance overall resolution, user satisfaction and KPIs.**Job Responsibilities**

The key responsibilities will include:  


* Collaborate with the team (and in particular Tech/Dev and project manager) to establish the best customer experience to reach the outcomes
* Realize the assessment and conversational AI strategy
* Responsible for building conversational scenarios and flows
* Build proto persona, bot persona and tone of voice and make voice proposal fitting with the brand expectation for Voicebots
* Participate actively in the KPI analysis, roadmap and continuous improvement of the bot
* Responsible for bot training and gen AI knowledge base reinforcement
* Elaborate and maintain in time conversational flows architecture (Miro / X mind)
* Elaborate and integrate conversational content based on text
* Manage testing, adjust testing protocol model to the project, realize on\-going testing of the experience built, identify testers and consolidate testing feedback
* Integrate changes or evolutions validated by the client during the run
**Skills and Qualifications**

Must have:  


* Strong understanding of Natural Language Processing
* Strong understanding of conversational UX and specificities of each channel: chat or voice
* Ability to take advantage of Gen AI capabilities and integrate it in conversational design when required
* Understanding of LLM functioning and RAG to optimize content for Knowledge AI content preparation for Generative AI \= prompt engineering capabilities
* Perfect written and verbal communication
* Ability to explain and defend design choices
* Ability to work in multicultural environment
* Continuous learning mindset


Must have:  


* Experience in conversational design for chatbots, voicebots, or virtual assistants
* Strong understanding of user experience (UX) principles and conversational flows
* Ability to write clear, natural, and engaging dialogue for different user personas
* Knowledge of NLP/NLU concepts and how AI interprets language
* Familiarity with conversational platforms (e.g., Cognigy)
* Ability to create and maintain dialogue trees, intents, and entities
* Collaboration skills to work with developers, AI engineers, and product teams
* Testing and iteration skills – ability to test conversations, analyze metrics, and improve flows
* Fluent in French \& English. Other languages are appreciated


Nice to have:
* Experience with voice interfaces and speech technologies (STT/TTS)
* Understanding of multilingual or cross\-cultural conversational design
* Basic coding or scripting skills for integration with AI platforms
* Knowledge of analytics tools to track user interactions and performance
* Experience with LLMs or generative AI for enhancing conversational responses
* Familiarity with accessibility and inclusive design principles

title: Gen AI /Agentic AI Engineer (CISCO USA)
description:
**Cisco is seeking a highly skilled GenAI/Agentic AI Engineer to work remotely from Egypt with the Cisco team in the US.** 
 The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in advanced AI systems, including retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), multimodal models, and agentic workflows. You will play a critical role in designing, developing, and deploying next\-generation intelligent systems that leverage generative AI, multi\-agent coordination, and real\-time learning to solve complex business problems at scale.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**AI System Design \& Development (Primary)** 




 Design and implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and graph\-RAG pipelines.
 



 Build and optimize multimodal models (text, code, vision, voice).
 



 Develop agentic AI systems with tool/function calling and workflow orchestration.
 



 Create and manage multi\-agent systems and hierarchical planning architectures.
 



 Integrate hybrid retrieval systems using knowledge graphs and vector databases.
 



 Implement continual and online learning with concept\-drift detection.
 



 Ensure robustness through red\-teaming, adversarial testing, and guardrail monitoring.
 



  





**Model Optimization \& Deployment** 




 Apply parameter\-efficient tuning methods (LoRA, prefix/prompt tuning).
 



 Perform model compression (distillation, quantization, pruning) for efficient edge/on\-device deployment.
 



 Implement privacy\-preserving ML techniques (federated learning, differential privacy).
 



 Enable secure inference and ensure compliance with data privacy standards.
 



 Integrate models with cloud and on\-prem infrastructures using modern MLOps practices.
 



  





**Evaluation, Explainability \& Governance** 




 Develop automated evaluation pipelines for generative model quality and reliability.
 



 Implement explainability and interpretability frameworks (XAI).
 



 Apply provenance, watermarking, and fact\-grounding for trustworthy outputs.
 



 Monitor data and model drift to maintain consistent system performance.
 



 Generate and use synthetic data for augmentation and model improvement.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 4\+ years of experience in machine learning or AI engineering, with a focus on generative AI or LLMs.
* Strong proficiency with Python and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or Hugging Face.
* Hands\-on experience with RAG, graph databases (Neo4j, ArangoDB), and vector stores (FAISS, Milvus, Pinecone).
* Deep understanding of multimodal model architectures and agentic AI design.
* Experience with model fine\-tuning (LoRA, RLHF, DPO) and orchestration frameworks.
* Familiarity with privacy\-preserving ML, federated learning, and secure deployment.
* Strong grasp of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Excellent problem\-solving, collaboration, and documentation skills.

title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
description:
CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients.

 **Why us?**


CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry\-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.


In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast\-paced, high\-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.


We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.


With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.


We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting\-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.

**Role:**

We are looking for an experienced LLM Engineer for our new Berlin AI lab who is passionate about agentic AI \- systems where models reason, act, and learn autonomously. You should have a proven track record of building scalable, production\-grade AI systems and a strong grasp of how to translate cutting\-edge research into real\-world impact. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with creativity and a bias for shipping practical, elegant solutions.


Your role sits at the intersection of our data and backend teams. You will design and implement advanced, (multi\-)agentic AI systems that apply LLMs not just as tools, but as autonomous collaborators \- reasoning over data, orchestrating workflows, and driving decisions. You’ll combine solid backend engineering with a deep understanding of how LLMs can act, learn, and adapt to solve complex user problems at scale.


This role is perfect for someone who loves turning cutting\-edge AI and NLP research into scalable systems, thrives on end\-to\-end ownership and autonomy, an experimentation\-welcoming setting, and wants to shape how agentic AI transforms enterprise software.


You will be working closely with the Head of Agentic AI Engineering and our compact high\-performance team of LLM engineers, software engineers, and data scientists. The team is part of recently acquired Berlin startup Kodex AI and works hybrid from an amazing office (great location, gym, rooftop pool \& sauna, many events), and from home.


Our evolving tech stack:

* Core: python (fastAPI, langchain), Typescript (React)
* Infra \& storage: MySQL, Pinecone, GCP, AWS, Azure, Firebase, Docker, github

**Qualifications:**

* 4\+ years of experience in software or LLM engineering, ideally with Python
* Strong foundation in backend or data systems, and experience deploying LLM\-based applications to production
* Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenDevin, or custom agentic architectures)
* Understanding of prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool\-use / agent frameworks, LLM evaluation, NLP methods
* Experience with most of our tech stack (as listed above)
* Bonus: experience building B2B SaaS or AI workflow products
* Bonus: experience in an early\-stage startup environment
* Bonus: experience in FinTech / RegTech / Finance / Regulatory / Compliance domains
* Great problem\-solving skills, a pragmatic mindset, and a bias toward fast iteration
* Curiosity and ability to learn new technologies quickly
* Strong English communication skills and comfort working in a small, startup\-like, tech\-driven team

**Interested?**


If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.


CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: AI Engineer (TeamCity)
description:
At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started back in 2000, we have been striving to make the world's most robust and effective developer tools. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.



The rapid rise of large language models has significantly changed how developers work. From smart code completion to full code generation, modern AI tools can now perform major code refactoring and build applications from scratch. This impact extends beyond coding into related fields – improving quality in a variety of areas including CI/CD, infrastructure management, project planning, marketing, translation, security analysis, and many more.



TeamCity is a CI/CD solution used by over 30,000 teams worldwide. The chances are high that one of your favorite applications was built using TeamCity, which means your impact here won’t be abstract — it will be truly tangible. TeamCity is actively contributing to the next chapter of AI integration by JetBrains. We’re not only exploring how to bring consumer AI experiences (like chats, agents, helpers, and assistants) into the developer workflow — we’re also tackling the orchestration of dozens of agents and systems working in concert.



We’re currently looking for a new teammate to join us in our AI initiatives.


### **As part of our team and in this role, you will:**


* Work with stakeholders to convert product requirements into technical specifications.
* Work with a highly skilled software engineering team and guide them in bringing AI features to customers.
* Take ownership of features from conception to implementation and evaluation.
* Design and implement AI workflows and agents.
* Be responsible for model selection, experimenting, fine\-tuning, and benchmarking, all using state\-of\-the\-art methods.
* Organize and analyze evaluation results and propose improvements to agentic systems.
* Collaborate with the AI platform team and share your knowledge and experience.
* Stay up to date with the latest advances in ML and AI technologies.

### **We will be happy to have you on our team if you have:**


* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field.
* A proven track record of developing and deploying AI agents in production environments.
* Proven experience building and maintaining reliable evaluation pipelines for AI/ML systems.
* Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Kotlin/Java.
* A deep understanding of statistical and mathematical principles underlying ML algorithms.
* The ability to work in a fast\-paced team with dynamic requirements.
* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
* The ability to handle multiple product directions simultaneously.

### **We’d be especially thrilled if you:**


* Have experience building RAG systems, working with vector databases, and using embeddings.
* Have a good understanding of LLM architecture, frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex, and other related features.
* Are familiar with CI/CD concepts, developer tooling, and general software engineering.
* Have a product management mindset.

title: Senior Product Designer – Enterprise AI Platform
description:

This is a great opportunity for an accomplished Senior Product Designer with a passion for simplifying technical complexity and elevating user experiences. This role will be a key force in shaping the end\-to\-end experience for an enterprise AI platform, empowering developers, AI Engineers, and enterprise users to create the next generation of AI\-powered tools in a way that feels intuitive, powerful, and delightful.  

  

Please note that the application deadline is **November 1, 2025**. We’ll begin reviewing applications only after that date. To ensure your application is considered, please submit it **through our career page or LinkedIn**. Applications sent via email or other channels won’t be reviewed.

At deepset, we’re on a mission to make custom AI solutions accessible to every organization. We’re remote\-first, flexible, and built on a culture of trust and ownership. #### **What you will do**

* End\-to\-end design: Lead the full product design process—from concept to delivery—while maintaining and evolving a unified design language for the AI platform and developer tools.
* Simplify Complexity: Translate advanced technical requirements (LLM orchestration, pipelines, governance, analytics, observability) into intuitive workflows and interfaces that balance power with usability and reduce cognitive load.
* User Empathy \& Advocacy: Engage with users and enterprise stakeholders to uncover pain points and workflow needs, translating insights into impactful design improvements that elevate the product experience.
* Collaborate Across Teams: Partner closely with PMs, engineers, and AI experts from discovery to delivery, contributing to agile workflows and using design thinking and storytelling to shape product direction.
* Establish \& Evolve Design Systems: Maintain and evolve a scalable design system that ensures consistency, usability, accessibility, and technical accuracy across all product surfaces.
* Elevate Design Culture: Promote best practices, strengthen design culture at deepset, and champion design\-led product development.

#### **Requirements**

* Experience: 5\+ years in product design, with a focus on complex B2B/SaaS products (ideally developer tools or data/AI platforms) and a track record of shipping solutions for technical workflows.
* Systems Thinker: Someone who sees the bigger picture—viewing complex problems as interconnected systems and focusing on the relationships and dependencies between elements.
* Technical Acumen: Confident working with engineers, grasping APIs and data flows, and turning abstract ideas into actionable designs.
* Full\-Stack Design Skills: Skilled across the design process—from research and journey mapping to prototyping, UI, interaction, and handoff to development.
* Collaboration \& Influence: Strong communicator who collaborates across teams and shapes product strategy with stakeholder alignment.
* Craft \& Efficiency: Balances attention to detail and visual polish with pragmatic iteration—knowing when to perfect and when to move fast.
* Empathy \& User\-Centeredness: Genuine focus on user outcomes, backed by a track record of research\-informed design decisions.
* You care: You’re passionate about building exceptional software you can be proud of.

#### **Nice to have**

* Experience designing for developer platforms, open\-source projects, AI/ML software, enterprise products, or technically challenging SaaS solutions.

#### **Benefits**

* Remote\-first setup with flexible hours \& tech of your choice
* 30 days vacation \+ extra days for family sick leave
* Competitive salary \& stock options for every team member
* Monthly sports \& mental health support allowance with Oliva
* Annual learning \& development budget
* Monthly team socials \& in\-person meetups
* Dog\-friendly Berlin HQ

Founded in 2018, deepset builds open and enterprise\-grade tools that help teams build AI with purpose. From Haystack, our open\-source framework, to the deepset AI Platform, we give developers and organizations the building blocks to solve complex, high impact challenges with AI – with full control, transparency, and sovereignty.  We are looking for an experienced LLM Engineer for our new Berlin AI lab who is passionate about agentic AI \- systems where models reason, act, and learn autonomously. You should have a proven track record of building scalable, production\-grade AI systems and a strong grasp of how to translate cutting\-edge research into real\-world impact. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with creativity and a bias for shipping practical, elegant solutions.

You’ll combine solid backend engineering with a deep understanding of how LLMs can act, learn, and adapt to solve complex user problems at scale.
   

  

 This role is perfect for someone who loves turning cutting\-edge AI and NLP research into scalable systems, thrives on end\-to\-end ownership and autonomy, an experimentation\-welcoming setting, and wants to shape how agentic AI transforms enterprise software.
   

  

 You will be working closely with the Head of Agentic AI Engineering and our compact high\-performance team of LLM engineers, software engineers, and data scientists. * Core: python (fastAPI, langchain), Typescript (React)
* Infra \& storage: MySQL, Pinecone, GCP, AWS, Azure, Firebase, Docker, github

* Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenDevin, or custom agentic architectures)

* Experience with most of our tech stack (as listed above)
* Bonus: experience building B2B SaaS or AI workflow products
* Bonus: experience in an early\-stage startup environment
* Bonus: experience in FinTech / RegTech / Finance / Regulatory / Compliance domains
* Great problem\-solving skills, a pragmatic mindset, and a bias toward fast iteration
* Curiosity and ability to learn new technologies quickly
* Strong English communication skills and comfort working in a small, startup\-like, tech\-driven team


**Interested?**

title: Senior Backend Developer / AI Engineer
description:
**Company** 



  


 We are a Berlin\-based B2C fintech operating in stealth, founded by two repeat founders (YC alum, exit) with prior 10\+ year careers in investment banking and strategy consulting, respectively. We recently raised investment to assemble a 15 people, exceptionally strong core team.
 


  


 Our culture is built on ownership and clarity. We align with you on vision, then set KPIs and required resources together—and then trust your drive and expertise.
 


  


**The Opportunity** 



  


 As a Senior Backend Developer / AI Engineer, you will work alongside our CTO on building and evolving our AI\-powered fintech product. The core architecture is in place, providing a solid foundation to build upon as we integrate advanced LLM capabilities, establish AI pipelines, implement intelligent automation, and ship production\-ready AI features. You'll be instrumental in shaping how we leverage AI to transform financial services, with significant autonomy to design and implement cutting\-edge solutions.
 


  

 Tasks
   


**What you will work on on daily basis** 



  

  
* Designing and implementing LLM\-powered features and intelligent automation workflows
  
* Building robust AI pipelines with proper orchestration, error handling, and monitoring
  
* Developing RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) systems for financial data processing
  
* Implementing and optimizing vector search and embedding strategies
  
* Creating evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs and maintaining quality standards
  
* Building prompt management systems and optimizing LLM interactions for cost and performance
  
* Integrating multiple AI models and managing model versioning/deployment
  
* Ensuring AI safety, reliability, and compliance in financial applications
  


  

 Requirements
   


**Hard Requirements** 



  

  
* LLM Framework Expertise: Deep hands\-on experience with LangChain.js, LangGraph for JavaScript, or similar Node.js\-based LLM frameworks. You understand agent architectures, chain composition, memory management, and can build complex multi\-step AI workflows in TypeScript/JavaScript.
  
* Workflow Orchestration: Production experience with Temporal .io (TypeScript SDK), Bull/BullMQ, or similar Node.js\-compatible orchestration solutions. You know how to build reliable, long\-running workflows with proper error handling, retries, and state management.
  
* Vector Database \& RAG Systems: Proven experience implementing RAG architectures using vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or pgvector) with Node.js clients. You understand embedding models, similarity search, and hybrid retrieval strategies.
  
* Node.js \& TypeScript Mastery: Expert\-level proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript with extensive experience integrating AI services (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere APIs). You're comfortable with streams, async patterns, WebSockets for real\-time AI responses, and optimizing for latency.
  


  


**Additional Technical Skills** 



  

  
* Experience with prompt engineering and prompt management systems accessible from Node.js
  
* Hands\-on experience with AI model APIs and their Node.js SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, Replicate)
  
* Knowledge of AI observability tools with Node.js integration (LangSmith, Helicone, or custom solutions)
  
* Proficiency with streaming architectures and Server\-Sent Events (SSE) for real\-time AI responses
  
* Understanding of AI safety, hallucination detection, and output validation techniques
  
* Familiarity with AI evaluation frameworks and automated testing of LLM outputs
  


  


**Mindset \& Approach** 



  

  
* AI\-Native Thinking: You think in terms of probabilistic systems, understand LLM limitations, and know how to design robust systems around non\-deterministic outputs.
  
* Pragmatic Innovation: You balance cutting\-edge AI capabilities with production requirements—knowing when to use simple solutions vs. complex AI architectures.
  
* Ownership Mentality: You're proactive, resourceful, and accountable for your work—you don't wait to be told what to do.
  
* Team Player: You collaborate well with others, can explain AI concepts to non\-technical stakeholders, and elevate those around you.
  
* Quality\-Focused: You understand the importance of evaluation, testing, and monitoring in AI systems and build with observability in mind.
  
* Continuous Learner: You stay current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape, experiment with new models and techniques, and are energized by pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
  


  

 Benefits
   


**Compensation \& How We Work** 



  

  
* Competitive salary commensurate with experience (€80k\-€110k\+ depending on seniority)
  
* On\-site in Berlin\-Mitte, with flexible remote work as you see fit (typically 3\-4 days in office, flexible on specific days)
  
* High autonomy, low politics, fast decision\-making—we value impact over process
  
* Top\-tier equipment—whatever tools you need to do your best work
  


  


*We're an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're excited about the role but don't meet 100% of the criteria, we'd still love to hear from you—particularly if you bring unique perspectives or experiences that would strengthen our team.*

#### **Deine Aufgaben**


As a Principal Generative AI Engineer bist du ein praxisnaher FachexpertIn mit Fokus auf Architektur und Implementierung von Agentic\-AI\-Systemen. Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreibst anspruchsvolle Multi\-Agent\-Workflows und autonome Systeme und verantwortest die technische Umsetzung vom Prototyp bis in die Produktion. Du setzt den Standard für zuverlässige, skalierbare und wirkungsvolle agentische Lösungen für unsere Partner und befähigst technische Teams, exzellente Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

* **Architect \& build:** Führe Design, Implementierung und Betrieb fortgeschrittener Multi\-Agent\-Systeme, agentischer Workflows und komplexer RAG\-Architekturen. Fokus auf robuste, State\-of\-the\-Art AI\-Agents, die reale Geschäftsprobleme in großem Maßstab lösen.
* **Own the delivery:** Steuere die End\-to\-End\-Entwicklung agentischer AI\-Programme und kritischer Projekte. Triff zentrale Entscheidungen zu Frameworks, Tools und Patterns, um hochwertigen, produktionsreifen Code und Systeme sicherzustellen.
* **Raise the bar:** Definiere, vermittle und setze hohe Standards für Systemdesign, Codequalität, Testing, Observability sowie Guardrails und Sicherheitsmaßnahmen für autonome Systeme durch.
* **Guide the team:** Hebe technische Projektteams durch klare technische Richtung, Stakeholder\-Alignment und Reduktion von Ambiguität auf das nächste Level. Treibe Architekturentscheidungen im Team, führe tiefgehende Design\- und Code\-Reviews durch und sorge für konsistente Best Practices über das gesamte Projekt hinweg.
* **Innovate hands\-on:** Experimentiere proaktiv mit den neuesten Entwicklungen im Bereich AI Agents (z. B. LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) und integriere diese, um unsere Lösungen und unseren Tech\-Stack kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
* **Partner with stakeholders:** Arbeite eng mit Delivery\- und Kunden\-Stakeholdern zusammen. Übersetze komplexe technische Konzepte in klare Empfehlungen und Roadmaps und vertrete die Agentic\-AI\-Vision intern und gegenüber Partnern.

#### **Dein Profil**

* Master\- oder PhD\-Abschluss in Informatik, Machine Learning oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet mit solider Basis in Software Engineering.
* 8\+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in Software\-/AI\-Engineering, davon 3\+ Jahre im Aufbau von Systemen mit Generativer KI und starkem Fokus auf AI Agents.
* Technisches Leadership: Du richtest technische Teams klar aus, übersetzt Visionen in nachvollziehbare Roadmaps und etablierst praktikable Standards. Durch deine Haltung und Expertise gewinnst du Vertrauen unabhängig von Hierarchien.
* Expertenniveau in Python sowie tiefgehende, praktische Erfahrung mit Agent\-Frameworks wie LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI oder ähnlichen. Du hast produktionsreife Systeme gebaut und ausgeliefert.
* Erfolgsbilanz in Architektur, Entwicklung und Auslieferung agentischer KI\-Lösungen oder komplexer LLM\-Anwendungen. Du verstehst den gesamten Lebenszyklus vom Prototyping bis Monitoring und Iteration.
* Tiefes Verständnis von Transformer\-Architekturen, Advanced RAG und agentischen Mustern (z. B. Planning, Tool Use, Multi\-Agent Collaboration).
* Fundierte Erfahrung mit Cloud\-Plattformen (Azure, AWS oder GCP) sowie MLOps/LLMOps\-Praktiken für das Deployen, Beobachten und Betreiben agentischer Systeme.
* Ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz; du fühlst dich in einer hands\-on Engineering\-Umgebung wohl und kannst komplexe Programme ganzheitlich (end\-to\-end) führen.

 Zu deinen Aufgaben zählen:
   

  

* Entwicklung und Training von KI\-/Machine\-Learning\-Modellen für Space\-Anwendungen (z. B. Bildverarbeitung, Objekterkennung, Sensordatenanalyse, Agents)
* Aufbau von End\-to\-End\-AI\-Lösungen sowie Integration von KI\-Systemen in bestehende IT\- und Raumfahrtumgebungen
* Signalverarbeitung und Datenvorverarbeitung unter besonderen Anforderungen
* Optimierung von KI\-Modellen für den Einsatz in „Edge“\-Umgebungen oder Onboard\-Systemen
* Zusammenarbeit mit Hardware\-, Software\- und Missionsplanungsteams, um praktikable Lösungen zu realisieren
* Testing, Validierung und Deployment unter realen oder simulierten Bedingungen
* Beratung von Kunden bei der Einführung von AI\-Infrastrukturen und Unterstützung bei der strategischen Weiterentwicklung


 Qualifikation
   

  

* Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Data Science, Mathematik, Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
* Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz und Machine Learning, idealerweise mit Projekten in komplexen IT\-Umgebungen.
* Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in gängigen KI\-/ML\-Frameworks (z. B. TensorFlow, PyTorch) mit.
* Du hast Erfahrung im Aufbau von End\-to\-End\-AI\-Lösungen sowie in der Integration von KI\-Systemen in bestehende IT\-Landschaften.
* Du überzeugst durch analytisches Denken, Kommunikationsstärke und sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse.


**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
 1976 gegründet und nach wie vor familiengeführt, ist CGI heute einer der weltweit größten unabhängigen Anbieter von IT und Business Consulting. Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Teamwork, Respekt und Zusammenhalt machen das Arbeiten bei uns besonders. Bei uns kannst du dein volles Potenzial entfalten!
   

  

 Du darfst dich vom ersten Tag an als Miteigentümer:in von CGI verstehen. Wir lassen unsere Vision gemeinsam Wirklichkeit werden. Wir profitieren von unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg und haben die Möglichkeit und die Verantwortung, die Strategie und Ausrichtung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten.
   

  

 Deine Arbeit schafft Mehrwert. Du findest innovative Lösungen und stärkst dein Netzwerk aus Kolleg:innen und Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du Zugang zu globalen Ressourcen, um große Ideen zu verwirklichen, neue Chancen zu nutzen und von der immensen Branchen\- und Technologie\-Kompetenz zu profitieren.
   

  

 Du bringst deine Karriere voran, da du in einem Unternehmen arbeitest, das auf Wachstum und Langlebigkeit ausgelegt ist. Du wirst von Führungskräften unterstützt, die deine Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit fördern – und dir Möglichkeiten bieten, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen und deinen Horizont zu erweitern.

**Company Description**
 We are SGS – the world's leading 5\-testing, inspection and certification company. Today, that mission is driven by data and technology. With 99,500 employees across 2,500 locations, we have a unique opportunity to build world\-class digital products. We are now launching a new Hub in Madrid to do just that. This is your opportunity to be the engine that brings our most ambitious ideas to life.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This is a role for a hands\-on AI builder who wants to solve high\-stakes business problems, fast. Working alongside our Principal engineers, you will turn complex, manual workflows into working code and deliver functional Proofs of Concept quickly.
   

  

 As our AI Engineer for Rapid Prototyping, you will be the core technical engine for our innovation projects. Your mission is to take on complex challenges involving unstructured documents and build working, end\-to\-end AI\-powered solutions. You will own the entire lifecycle from data extraction and processing to building the core logic and demonstrating the value.
   

  

* Automating Certificate Validation: You will take our existing prototypes for product safety certificates (GCC/CPC) and build the crucial missing pieces. This includes implementing the core cross\-validation logic against test reports, consolidating the data and delivering a functional system.
* Building an Intelligent Protocol Hub: You will tackle the ambiguous challenge of transforming hundreds of dense technical protocols into a smart, queryable database. This involves enhancing our Selenium web scrapers, building decoders, and using LLMs to intelligently extract and link cited standards from raw text.
* Delivering Interactive Demos: For every project, you will rapidly build a functional web interface (using Streamlit, Gradio, or FastAPI) to demonstrate the solution's value to stakeholders and gather immediate feedback.
* Proving Value with Data: You will be responsible for implementing and running performance evaluations on your POCs to generate the empirical data that proves their efficacy and guides the next steps


**Qualifications**
* Python Mastery: Expert\-level Python and its data ecosystem (Pandas, etc.) is non\-negotiable.
* Hands\-on LLM \& NLP: Proven experience building applications with LLMs for information extraction (RAG, function calling). Direct experience with commercial LLM is a must.
* Full\-Stack Prototyping: You must be able to build a complete, functional demo. This includes data processing on the backend and a simple UI on the frontend (Streamlit, Gradio, FastAPI).
* Web Scraping \& Document Processing: You are comfortable with tools like Selenium and Beautiful Soup, as well as libraries for handling PDFs and other document formats (e.g., PyMuPDF).
* Pragmatic Data Skills: You can design a simple database schema (SQL), write the necessary queries, and are comfortable with the entire data wrangling process


**Who You Are**
* A Hacker and a Maker: You have a builder's DNA and are driven by the desire to create things that work, fast.
* Versatile and Adaptable: You are excited by the idea of switching between a well\-defined integration project and a completely ambiguous exploratory one
* A full\-stack problem solver: You have a broad skillset and can comfortably handle data engineering. AI scripting and building a simple UI
* Biased Towards Action: You would rather build a simple version in a day than debate a perfect version in a week
* Creative and Resourceful: You see a collection of tools and problems and instinctively know how to combine them to create a solution


**Additional Information**
**What We Offer**
* Competitive Compensation: A strong salary and benefits package for a high\-impact builder.
* End\-to\-End Project Ownership: You won't just work on a small feature. You will own entire prototypes from data ingestion to the final demo, with the autonomy to choose the right tools.
* High\-Velocity Impact: Be the engine of innovation for the Hub, rapidly delivering the POCs that prove what's possible and guide our product strategy.
* A Compelling Problem Space: Apply your skills to unique, tangible problems in global safety, sustainability, and supply chains that few others get to see.
* Growth \& Mentorship: Work directly with and learn from our Principal engineers in a world\-class environment, with a clear path to grow your skills and career.

Your core mission is delivery, optimized for velocity and reliability: taking proven AI/ML models, LLM prototypes, and intelligent agents and integrating them directly into our product infrastructure. * Strong Product Mindset: A passion for shipping, learning, and achieving tangible business outcomes (like reducing investigation time). You start with the user problem and work backward, turning complex technical ideas into reliable, high\-impact product features.

You are an excellent collaborator and communicator, able to bridge the gap between Data Science, Product, and other engineers.

 N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

Hospitality is tough – margins are thin, waste is high, and teams are stretched. But it doesn’t have to be this hard. That’s why we built **Nory**.


Our CEO, Conor, knows the pain first\-hand. After founding and scaling Mad Egg in Ireland, he got fed up with juggling “market\-leading” systems, clunky spreadsheets, and endless printouts. So he set out to build the tool he wished he’d had from day one.


Nory is an all\-knowing restaurant management system. It blends real\-time data with AI predictive analytics, giving operators control of their margins. From food prep to forecasting, it’s operational intelligence that helps restaurants run with consistency, certainty, and profit. The result? Thriving restaurants, better jobs, less waste, healthier margins.


And we’re just getting started. Fresh off a Series B led by Kinnevik, we’ve grown to 70\+ people across Ireland, the UK, and Spain – and demand is scaling faster than we ever imagined.

In this role, you’ll **build and scale production\-grade AI agents that transform how hospitality operators interact with data and automation at Nory.** This is not a research role — it’s a hands\-on engineering position at the edge of what’s possible in applied AI. • Familiarity with Data engineering and Machine learning models


• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, flexible and good attitude


• Experience working with open\-source projects, third\-party libraries, SDKs and APIs


• Practical experience training/fine\-tuning SLMs/LLMs (e.g., Llama, Mistral) using techniques such as LoRA/QLoRA, PEFT, and prompt\-tuning; knowledge of evaluation frameworks and benchmark design.


• Strong grasp of ML fundamentals (supervised/unsupervised learning, bias/variance, cross\-validation), NLP techniques, and vector embeddings; hands\-on with PyTorch/TensorFlow and scikit\-learn.


• Experience with LLM/RAG tooling and NLP stacks (Hugging Face Transformers/Datasets, LangChain or LlamaIndex) and vector databases (pgvector/Postgres, Pinecone, Milvus, or Azure AI Search).


• Proficiency with experiment tracking and model registries (MLflow, Weights \& Biases) and feature stores; comfort with disciplined experiment design and reproducibility.


• Model serving and optimization expertise: vLLM, ollama, Text Generation Inference, Triton, ONNX Runtime; quantization (bitsandbytes/INT8/FP8, GPTQ/AWQ), distillation, and caching/batching strategies.

Apply best practices for model adaptation, evaluation, and deployment, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with business objectives.

 Code (Bicep/Terraform).

description:

**Overview** 
 Chambers and Partners is transforming how the worlds leading legal professionals access insight and intelligence and were looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help drive that innovation.
   

  

 In this pivotal role, youll design, develop, and deploy advanced AI and machine learning solutions that power our next generation of products and research capabilities. Collaborating closely with our architecture, research, analytics, and product teams, youll bring creativity and technical expertise to the forefront of our data and technology strategy.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering position focused on building and operating production\-grade LLM applications on Azure. Youll work on AI\-enabled and augmented intelligence solutions such as retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and model integrations with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, security, and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Main Duties and Responsibilities** 
**Data \& Retrieval**
* Build robust ingestion pipelines for PDFs/Word/Excel/Audio/JSON and semi\-structured sources.
* Design RAG systems : chunking strategies, document schemas, metadata, hybrid/dense retrieval, re\-ranking, and grounding.
* Manage vector/keyword indexes (e.g., Azure AI Search , pgvector, Pinecone/Weaviate).
* Develop and deploy advanced NLP, information retrieval, and recommendation systems that enhance Chambers and Partners research and product offerings, including document understanding, automatic summarisation, topic modelling, semantic search, entity recognition, and relationship extraction.
* Design and implement intelligent tagging and metadata enrichment frameworks to categorize and organize legal and market data, improving search, discoverability, and insight accuracy.


**LLM \& Machine Learning Application Engineering**
* Design, build, and maintain traditional ML and LLM models and pipelines .
* Build LLM apps using LangGraph/LangChain : tools/function calling, structured outputs (JSON Schema), agents, and multi\-step reasoning.
* Implement ASR/TTS and multimodal where relevant (e.g., Whisper ).
* Choose customization paths pragmatically: prompt engineering , system prompts, tools, adapters/LoRA, and selective fine\-tuning only when needed.
* Fine\-tune and optimize ML models and LLMs to enhance performance, efficiency, and relevance for Chambers research, analytics, and product applications. Apply best practices for model adaptation, evaluation, and deployment, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with business objectives.


**Platform \& Operations (LLMOps)**
* Deploy and operate services on Azure (AKS/ACI/Azure Functions, API Management).
* Implement CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps), Infrastructure as Code (Bicep/Terraform), secrets via Azure Key Vault , private networking.
* Add observability : tracing/telemetry (OpenTelemetry, LangSmith), metrics, logs, cost and token usage monitoring, alerts.
* Apply evaluation \& QA : regression suites, offline eval sets/golden data, RAG evals (faithfulness, answer relevance, citation correctness), A/B tests, win\-rate testing.
* Ensure reliability : rate\-limit handling, retries/backoff, idempotency, circuit breakers, caching (e.g., Redis/semantic cache), fallbacks and degradations.


**Governance, Safety \& Security**
* Enforce PII handling , data minimization, redaction, access controls, and auditability.
* Mitigate prompt injection/jailbreak risks; apply content filters/guardrails; track data residency.
* Establish and drive best practices for model versioning, reproducibility, performance monitoring, bias mitigation, data governance, and ethical AI use .
* Document architectural decisions, runbooks, and operational procedures.


**Software Engineering \& Collaboration**
* Write clean, tested, maintainable code in Python (and optionally .NET).
* Apply SOLID, TDD/BDD where sensible, code reviews, refactoring, performance profiling.
* Collaborate in an Agile environment; contribute to technical specs and implementation plans.
* Build POCs to de\-risk architecture and showcase value; harden POCs into production services.
* Mentor and guide more junior engineers and data scientists; review code; contribute to technical design reviews; raise the collective standard of the team.
* Stay abreast of the AI/ML research landscape and legal\-tech/legal\-analytics domain to bring relevant innovations into our stack.


**Skills And Experience**
* Significant demonstrable experience in software engineering, with 2\+ years building LLM/AI applications in production.
* Strong in Python, API design, asynchronous programming, and integration patterns.
* Proven ability to scale LLMs and other AI models for high\-volume, real\-world applications, including optimizing inference, managing computational resources, and ensuring reliability and maintainability.


 Programming \& ML/LLM Frameworks
   

  

* Strong expertise in Python and relevant ML/LLM libraries/frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn).
* Strong in Python, API design, asynchronous programming, and integration patterns. Hands\-on with LangGraph / LangChain, LlamaIndex or Semantic Kernel for orchestration (tools, agents, guards, structured I/O).
* Familiarity with Azure OpenAI and at least one open model stack (e.g., Llama/Mistral via vLLM/TGI/Ollama).
* Proficient with Front end Frameworks such as Angular, for integration of AI\-powered applications
* Experience with graph databases and knowledge graphs (Neo4j) for knowledge graphs and tool routing.


 Cloud deployment \& MLOps
   

  

* Production deployments on Azure (AKS/ACI/Functions), CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code (Bicep/Terraform).
* Production deployments on Azure (AKS, ACI, Functions, API Management) ; solid understanding of cloud platforms and data infrastructure


 Data \& Information Management
   

  

* Experience with relational / semi\-structured database (MS SQL and Cosmos DB) and vector search indexing (Azure AI Search/pgvector/Pinecone/Weaviate/Milvus/Qdrant) plus neo4j or equivalent graph database.


 Software Engineering \& Architecture
   

  

* Solid grasp of SDLC practices : unit/integration/E2E testing, code review, documentation, and maintainable software development.
* Able to implement key architectural outcomes, including reusability, performance, separation of concerns, and quality integrity .
* Experience in asynchronous programming, API design, and integration patterns .
* Experience with ASR/TTS productionisation (Whisper, Azure Cognitive Services) and audio pipelines is desirable.


 Governance, Security \& Compliance
   

  

* Strong understanding of security, compliance, and ethical AI practices , including Key Vault, private endpoints, PII handling, RBAC, data governance, and bias mitigation.
* Awareness of ethical and responsible AI use , including model versioning, reproducibility, and evaluation best practices.


**Person Specification**
* A passionate software engineer/ Data Scientist with a history of driving his or her own technical and professional development.
* Worked in the media, publishing, research or a similar consumer focused industry. (Highly Desirable)
* Communication \- Able to clearly communicate complex technical subjects to team members and stakeholders.
* Able to Lead, providing thought leadership in their domain
* Attention to Detail \- focused on the finer details that make the difference.
* Delivery Focus \- pragmatic and driven to get solutions live.
* Be comfortable and motivated to deliver on personal KPIs
* A Proactive attitude. A self\-starter who seeks out opportunities for yourself and your team.
* Awareness of industry trends \- such as challenges and best practices.
* Positive attitude \- generating enthusiasm among team members
* Able to build strong personal relationships and trust.

**Let’s fix hospitality, for good.**


Hospitality is tough – margins are thin, waste is high, and teams are stretched. But it doesn’t have to be this hard. That’s why we built **Nory**.


Our CEO, Conor, knows the pain first\-hand. After founding and scaling Mad Egg in Ireland, he got fed up with juggling “market\-leading” systems, clunky spreadsheets, and endless printouts. So he set out to build the tool he wished he’d had from day one.


Nory is an all\-knowing restaurant management system. It blends real\-time data with AI predictive analytics, giving operators control of their margins. From food prep to forecasting, it’s operational intelligence that helps restaurants run with consistency, certainty, and profit. The result? Thriving restaurants, better jobs, less waste, healthier margins.


And we’re just getting started. Fresh off a Series B led by Kinnevik, we’ve grown to 70\+ people across Ireland, the UK, and Spain – and demand is scaling faster than we ever imagined.


We’re now looking for a **Senior AI Engineer** to join our growing **Insights Team**. In this role, you’ll **build and scale production\-grade AI agents that transform how hospitality operators interact with data and automation at Nory.** This is not a research role — it’s a hands\-on engineering position at the edge of what’s possible in applied AI. You’ll help define what “production\-grade AI” looks like at Nory and set the bar for how we build, deploy, and scale intelligent systems that power a more profitable, sustainable hospitality industry.

### **What you’ll be doing**


As an **AI Engineer** at Nory, you’ll bring our AI roadmap to life \- designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents that supercharge restaurant operations. You’ll work at the intersection of data, engineering, and product, turning cutting\-edge AI into real\-world impact for hospitality operators.

**Here’s what you will be responsible for:**

* **Adapt and deploy pre\-trained models** using techniques such as prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and fine\-tuning to create reliable, context\-aware AI agents.
* **Build and scale production\-grade infrastructure** that allows models and agents to run efficiently, securely, and at scale across our customer base.
* **Integrate AI capabilities into core Nory workflows**, collaborating closely with product, design, and data teams to deliver measurable value to customers.
* **Solve real operational problems** using AI to improve forecasting, automate insights, and reduce friction for restaurant teams.
* **Monitor and optimise live systems** to improve model inference speed, cost\-efficiency, and quality, informed by user feedback and data.
* **Collaborate across disciplines**, helping shape Nory’s broader AI strategy while sharing learnings and best practices with other engineers.

* **Proven experience leading, building and running LLM\-based or agentic workflows in production**, using frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar. You’ve built multi\-step workflows, orchestrated tools or APIs, and handled failure modes and retries.
* **Solid grounding in AI and ML concepts**, from model fine\-tuning and embeddings to NLP and real\-world optimisation, including prompt engineering, RAG, and evaluation frameworks.

* **Comfort with data engineering,** building or maintaining data pipelines, handling large datasets, and instrumenting models for feedback loops.
* **Strong commercial awareness,** you understand how to apply AI to deliver real business value, not just technical novelty.
* **A startup mindset,** you thrive in fast\-paced environments, move quickly, and take initiative to maintain momentum and resolve issues efficiently. You are comfortable with ambiguity and multitask effectively while delivering real impact.


If you’re excited by what we’re building, we’d love to hear from you \- even if you don’t tick every box.

### **What you’ll get in return**


Competitive salary range


Meaningful equity – at Nory, everyone is an owner


35 days of paid leave per year (including bank holidays)


Comprehensive private health insurance via Irish Life (Ireland) and AXA (UK)


Enhanced parental leave and baby loss support


€1,000 annual L\&D budget \+ quarterly book budget


€250 home office workspace budget


Regular team offsites and socials


Offices in **London** (LABS House) or **Dublin** (Dogpatch Labs)


And much more

### **How we work**


Our vision is to build a better future for the restaurant industry \- one where operators are in control, margins are stronger, and frontline teams can build careers they’re proud of. To get there, we move fast, stay focused, and hold ourselves to a high bar. Our values guide how we work, grow, and win – together.

**We serve up impact with a side of profit.**


We prioritise work that delivers real financial results for our restaurant partners.

**We prioritise speed of service.**


We move fast, unblock quickly, and deliver with urgency.

**We act like owners.**


We own problems, raise the bar, and build better every day.

**We win as a crew.**


We grow stronger through feedback, collaboration, and shared wins.

### **We hire humans.**


At Nory, we believe that diverse teams build better products. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and walks of life. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, family status, age, disability, or race. title: AI Engineer
description:
**Overview:**
 Guidepoint seeks an experienced AI Engineer as an integral member of the Toronto\-based Data team. The Toronto Technology Hub serves as the base of our Data/AI/ML team, dedicated to building a modern data infrastructure for advanced analytics and the development of responsible AI.
   

  

 This role requires strong technical expertise and leadership to design, implement, and scale intelligent systems that leverage large language models (LLMs), advanced ML pipelines and Building Agents in Databricks. You will drive the development of AI evaluation frameworks, scalable deployment practices, and robust monitoring systems to ensure quality, reliability, and responsible AI outcomes. The AI/ML Engineer will play a key role in expanding Guidepoint’s AI/ML capabilities using Databricks and other modern cloud\-native tools.
   

  

**This is a hybrid position based in Toronto.**
**What You’ll Do:**
* Design and implement LLM\-powered solutions such as retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, Build, scale, and optimize GenAI and ML workloads across Databricks and other production environments, focusing on cost\-efficiency, compliance, and reliability
* Develop robust AI evaluation frameworks and monitoring systems for continuous model assessment, including rubric\-based scoring and human\-in\-the\-loop validation
* Implement AI agents capable of handling complex queries and delivering insights from structured and unstructured data sources
* Build ML pipelines to train, serve, and monitor supervised, reinforcement, and LLM\-based models using Databricks and MLflow
* Explore strategies such as fine\-tuning, few\-shot learning, and prompt engineering to adapt open\-source and proprietary LLMs
* Collaborate with data engineering and data science teams to establish best practices for LLMOps, observability, and responsible AI integration
* Contribute to the architecture of intelligent systems that combine GenAI with real\-time data, APIs, and domain\-specific tools
* Partner with product and client services teams to define priorities and align AI capabilities with business outcomes


**What You Have:**
* 4\+ years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3\+ years with a Master’s degree; or 1\+ year with a PhD
* Proven experience designing and deploying Generative AI/LLM applications (e.g., ASR Models,GPT\-4, Gemini, Claude, open\-weight models)
* Hands\-on expertise with Gen AI Pipelines, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings\-based search, agent orchestration, and prompt chaining
* Familiarity with modern LLM/GenAI frameworks (Mosaic AI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, HuggingFace, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph)
* Strong technical proficiency in Python, Databricks, Azure, FastAPI, Kubernetes,
* 4\+ years of hands\-on industry experience in AI application development
* Proven ability to design AI evaluation pipelines. LLMOps, monitoring frameworks for production\-grade LLM/ML systems
* Demonstrated leadership in building and scaling applied AI/ML systems for real\-world use cases
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills across engineering, product, and business teams
* Familiarity with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and large\-scale data processing with Apache Spark
* Knowledge of personalization techniques, NLP\-based modeling, and applied ML for user experience optimization
* Experience with fine\-tuning LLMs and embedding models for domain\-specific tasks
* Understanding of responsible AI practices, including explainability, compliance, and bias mitigation

* Comprehensive benefits plan
* Company RRSP Match
* Development opportunities through the LinkedIn Learning platform

title: Développeur ou Développeuse en IA générative / plateforme Power
description:
**Aperçu**
 Chez KPMG, vous ferez partie d’une équipe diversifiée et dévouée de professionnels de la résolution de problèmes ayant un objectif commun traduire l’information en occasions pour nos clients et nos communautés partout dans le monde.
   

  

 Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne dynamique et dotée du sens des affaires pour se joindre à notre équipe à titre de développeur ou développeuse en IA générative / plateforme Power. Ce rôle met l’accent sur le développement d’agents d’IA et d’agents Copilot à l’aide d’outils comme Copilot Studio et Azure OpenAI. La personne idéale comblera l’écart entre les besoins du cabinet et les solutions techniques en jouant un rôle hybride qui combine des connaissances en développement à la gestion de projet et à l’engagement des parties prenantes.
   

  

**Ce que vous ferez**
* Concevoir et intégrer des capacités d’IA générative et des solutions agentiques telles que des agents d’IA à l’aide de Copilot Studio, de la plateforme Power de Microsoft et d’outils connexes
* Développer et gérer des connecteurs, des API et des intégrations d’IA personnalisées à l’aide de systèmes d’entreprise, notamment ServiceNow et d’Agent Studio de Moveworks
* Concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions à l’aide de la plateforme Power de Microsoft (Power Apps, Power Automate, AI Builder)
* Collaborer avec les parties prenantes du cabinet pour recueillir, interpréter et traduire les exigences en solutions d’automatisation intelligente
* Prendre en charge le cycle de vie complet de la solution, de l’idéation et du prototypage au déploiement et à la maintenance
* Veiller à ce que les solutions soient sécurisées, évolutives et conformes aux normes d’architecture d’entreprise


**Ce que vous apportez au rôle**
* Diplôme en sciences informatiques ou formation équivalente.
* Solides compétences en relations interpersonnelles et en communication, et capacité d’interagir avec des utilisateurs professionnels et des équipes techniques.
* Passion pour l’innovation en IA et solide compréhension de la façon d’appliquer l’IA générative aux défis commerciaux réels.
* Capacité de gérer de multiples priorités et d’obtenir des résultats de grande qualité dans un environnement dynamique.
* Expérience de travail au sein d’équipes interfonctionnelles et dans des environnements de développement agiles.
* Être à l’aise avec l’ambiguïté et avoir la volonté de prendre des initiatives et de s’approprier les résultats.


 Compétences techniques
   

  

* Expérience avec Copilot Studio, Azure AI Studio et les modèles d’IA générative (p. ex., GPT\-4\)
* Solide compréhension des modèles d’orchestration des agents d’IA, de RAG (génération augmentée de récupération), de modèles d’IA générative (petits et grands modèles de langage) et d’ingénierie de requêtes
* Maîtrise de la plateforme Power de Microsoft (Power Apps, Power Automate et Power Virtual Agents)
* Expérience en développement et en résolution de problèmes dans SharePoint Online, particulièrement avec l’intégration aux solutions d’IA agentique et à la plateforme Power
* Expérience en matière de rôles de sécurité infonuagique et de création d’entités personnalisées
* Maîtrise de Dataverse, des API, des connecteurs et des stratégies d’intégration
* Expérience des méthodes agiles et des pratiques DevOps
* Capacité à programmer en Python et JSON
* Connaissance des plateformes infonuagiques (Azure, AWS, etc.) et des technologies de conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)
* Familiarité avec l’intégration de ServiceNow et d’Agent Studio de Moveworks (un atout)
* Connaissance d’Azure AI Services et d’Azure AI Foundry (un atout)
* Les certifications telles que Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate, PL\-200 ou PL\-400 sont un atout


 Ce poste requiert une maîtrise écrite et orale de l’anglais. La personne retenue devra soutenir ses collègues ou des parties prenantes anglophones d’autres provinces, ou collaborer avec ceux\-ci.

 L’échelle salariale de base prévue pour ce poste est de 74,400 $ à 111,600 $ et des primes pourraient s’y ajouter. La rémunération d’un candidat ou d’une candidate est établie en fonction de son emplacement, de ses connaissances, de ses compétences et de ses aptitudes. En plus de la rémunération, KPMG offre un programme d’avantages complet et concurrentiel.

 , nous faisons ce qui est juste \|

 , nous pensons et agissons avec audace \|

title: Architecte de Solution en Intelligence Artificielle (IA)
description:
Our internal AI practice is growing rapidly .
   

  

 At CGI, we are building an elite team of true technical stars, and we are now looking for an ally, a partner to help us shape the future of CGI \& AI.
   

  

 This is more than just a job: it’s an opportunity to contribute to a center of expertise in expansion, within a team that is human, collaborative, friendly, and has a great sense of humor . Here, professionalism goes hand in hand with teamwork and the joy of building something meaningful together.
   

  

 CGI is a global leader in IT and digital transformation services. We are at the forefront of innovation, helping our clients integrate artificial intelligence solutions that transform their operations and support strategic decision\-making.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

* Design and develop robust, scalable architectures for AI and machine learning solutions aligned with client business needs.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Developers) to ensure delivery of optimized and high\-performing solutions.
* Lead the selection and integration of AI platforms, frameworks, and tools (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn, etc.).
* Ensure governance and lifecycle management of AI models using MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or SageMaker.
* Deploy AI solutions in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) leveraging services such as Azure Machine Learning, AWS SageMaker, or Google AI Platform.
* Develop strategies for big data processing, model training, and integration with enterprise pipelines.
* Ensure security, ethics, and compliance of AI systems, in alignment with regulations (GDPR, Responsible AI).
* Conduct technology feasibility studies and Proof of Concepts (POCs) to validate AI solution adoption.
* Actively contribute to technology watch and integrate the latest AI advances into client projects.
* Train and mentor internal teams as well as clients on AI development best practices.


**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
* Minimum 7 years of experience in developing technology solutions, including at least 3 years in AI solution architecture.
* Expertise in AI, machine learning, and either Natural Language Processing (NLP) or Computer Vision.
* Strong knowledge of machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras) and Python libraries (scikit\-learn, pandas, NumPy).
* Experience implementing AI solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and integrating with services such as Data Lake, BigQuery, or Azure Synapse.
* Skills in designing data pipelines and automation using tools like Airflow or Step Functions.
* Deep understanding of responsible AI models and ethical considerations in solution deployment.
* Excellent communication skills to engage with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Bilingual (French and English), with strong presentation and knowledge\-sharing abilities.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Cloud certifications (AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Azure AI Engineer Associate, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer).
* Experience with distributed architectures and high\-performance frameworks (Spark, Dask, etc.).
* Proficiency in advanced visualization and data storytelling tools (Tableau, Power BI, Dash).
* Knowledge of Agile methodologies for AI project delivery.


**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
 Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
   

  

 You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
   

  

 Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
   

  

 You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
   

  

 At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive.  Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.
   

  

 Architecte de Solution en Intelligence Artificielle (IA)
   

  

**Job Description**
 Notre pratique interne en intelligence artificielle est en pleine expansion .
   

  

 Chez CGI, nous bâtissons une équipe d’élite composée de véritables vedettes techniques, et nous cherchons aujourd’hui un allié, un partenaire pour façonner avec nous l’avenir de CGI \& AI.
   

  

 C’est plus qu’un poste : c’est l’opportunité de contribuer à un centre d’expertise en croissance, au sein d’une équipe humaine, collaborative, amicale et dotée d’un solide sens de l’humour . Ici, le professionnalisme se conjugue avec l’esprit d’équipe et le plaisir de travailler ensemble.
   

  

 CGI est une entreprise mondiale de premier plan dans les services en technologies de l'information et la transformation numérique. Nous sommes à l’avant\-garde de l’innovation, aidant nos clients à intégrer des solutions d'intelligence artificielle qui transforment leurs opérations et favorisent la prise de décisions stratégiques.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

* Concevoir et développer des architectures robustes et évolutives pour des solutions d’intelligence artificielle et d’apprentissage automatique alignées sur les besoins métier des clients.
* Collaborer avec les équipes multidisciplinaires (Data Scientists, Data Engineers, développeurs) pour garantir la livraison de solutions optimisées et performantes.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**ELITS Canada Inc** 
 . is a subsidiary of Accelerate at Iver. Our parent company Iver has 1,700 employees today and is growing and now we are looking for new employees who want to join our journey. As part of Accelerate at Iver, you are at the absolute forefront of technology and work on exciting digitization and transformation projects with market\-leading customers. We are passionate about realizing digital opportunities in the cloud. Together with our customers, we close the gap between aspiration and successful implementation. Communication is an essential part of the work since we work closely with our customers. As an employee at ELITS you will become a part of a great team that always responds to the customer with humility, and at the same time is very proud of what we deliver.
   

  

 ELITS is now looking for an
 **AI Engineer** 
 for our operations in
 **Montreal** 
 .
   

  

**About this position:**
 As a Mid\-Senior AI Engineer, you will be responsible for turning AI and machine learning models into robust, scalable production solutions. Your expertise in model deployment, performance optimization, and workflow automation will help deliver critical insights and operational excellence. You’ll collaborate with Data Scientists, MLOps engineers, and application teams to ensure solutions are reliable and high\-performing in real\-world scenarios.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Productionize machine learning models and deploy them at scale using best\-practice engineering principles.
* Tune model and infrastructure performance for speed, scalability, and resource efficiency.
* Build end\-to\-end automated pipelines for model serving, monitoring, and management.
* Collaborate with data scientists to transition prototypes to production, refactoring code as needed.
* Implement testing, validation, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) for ML workflows.
* Monitor deployed models, proactively address drift and performance issues, and execute retraining as required.
* Apply containerization, orchestration, and cloud MLOps tooling to manage models in production.
* Document processes, performance metrics, and system configurations for collaboration and reproducibility.


**Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 4\+ years experience in AI/ML engineering, with a focus on production environments.
* Hands\-on expertise with Python, Java, or equivalent programming languages.
* Experience with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn) and deployment tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Expertise in pipeline automation, CI/CD for ML, and model performance monitoring.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and workflow orchestration.
* Proven track record of optimizing deployed AI systems for real\-world applications.
* Strong problem\-solving and technical communication skills.


**Preferred:**
* Experience transitioning models from R\&D to production in enterprise settings.
* Prior exposure to MLOps tools (MLflow, Seldon, Kubeflow, Airflow).
* Contributions to open\-source or published work in AI/ML engineering.


****Qualities:****
* Communicative and a positive attitude towards customers and colleagues
* Analytical skills, logical reasoning, and excellent problem\-solving skills
* Sense of responsibility, autonomy, and resourcefulness
* Team player, organized, and strive for results and quality
* Creative with ideas to improve the product
* Ability to coordinate and handle more than one task at the same time
* Being proactive


 Are you a social, flexible, and structured person with a great interest in information technology? Do you find development, constructing, and use of the latest technologies challenging? In that case – send your application to us today!
   

  

 This position is open to Canadian residents (persons with work permit in Canada).
   

  

 ELITS \- Accelerate at Iver

title: AI Engineer
description:
**Introduction:**  

About us
  
We are an award winning, national $16B public offer industry fund focused on the education and community sectors. Working for NGS Super means being part of something bigger and working to make a difference to our members and their financial future.
  
  

Our people are key to our success, and as we expand, we’re committed to finding and retaining the right talent to take on the journey. As well as a flexible and fun workplace, we offer competitive benefits including additional leave entitlements, personal \& professional development and health \& wellbeing programs.
  
  

Click on the video below to learn more!
  
  

The Role
  
We’re looking for an AI Engineer to join our newly formed Engineering team in Sydney in a 12 month fixed\-term role. Reporting to the Head of Engineering, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and deploying advanced AI solutions that directly support the data\-driven decision\-making needs of NGS Super’s Investment Team.
  
  

Your focus will be partnering with the Investment Team to build scalable, secure, and high\-performance AI/ML models that optimise investment strategies and product decisions, and contribute to the architecture and delivery of intelligent systems that integrate seamlessly with the Fund’s broader technology ecosystem.
  
  

What you’ll do
  
  

* Design, develop and deploy scalable AI/ML models to support investment modelling, forecasting, and optimisation activities.
* Collaborate closely with the Investments Team to translate complex financial and data requirements into robust AI solutions.
* Build and maintain intelligent systems that integrate with existing backend services, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
* Apply advanced techniques in natural language processing, graph\-based modelling, and supervised/unsupervised learning.
* Develop and maintain secure, production\-grade AI workloads using cloud\-native tools and infrastructure\-as\-code practices.
* Maintain strong documentation of all design decisions, procedures, and playbooks.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and incident response to ensure quality and maintainability of AI systems.
* Work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams including Data Engineers, Backend Developers, and Cloud Engineers to support end\-to\-end delivery.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies and recommend improvements or new approaches.


About you
  
  

* An analytical and solutions\-focused technical engineer, you will bring the following key skills:
* Demonstrated experience designing and deploying AI/ML models in production environments, specifically AWS.
* Strong proficiency in machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g. TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn).
* Experience with natural language processing, graph\-based modelling, and deep learning techniques.
* Solid understanding of data engineering principles and integration with backend systems.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native development, infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD practices.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or other relevant languages.
* Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into technical AI solutions.
* Commitment to secure coding practices and compliance with data governance standards.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills across technical and non\-technical teams.


**The following are nice to have but not essential:**  

* Experience working in an APRA\-regulated or similar financial services environment.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure, including AI/ML services.
* Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools for model lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of financial modelling or investment analytics.
* Relevant certifications in AI/ML, cloud technologies, or data science.


If you are looking for a long\-term contract where you can make an impact in a period of growth and technical transformation, we would love to hear from you.
  
  

We are a super fund that has an exceptional work culture, provides a diverse offering in developing our people and you can be a part of it while earning an attractive remuneration package!
  
  

Interested and suitably qualified candidates should submit a copy of their updated CV.
  
  

Please note that to be eligible for this role, you are required to have permanent Australian working rights and residency.
  
  

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a workplace that values diversity, equity, and respect for all individuals.

description:
As a Technical Business Analyst (Manager) within PwC Australia’s Digital – Data \& AI practice, you will lead the analysis and delivery of complex data, analytics, and AI transformation initiatives. **Why PwC?**


At PwC, we believe that technology and data are key catalysts for business transformation.
